size.value: Not more than 5cm × 5cm (5×5cm), must be taken by a professional photographer; two (2) photographs required per application

size.evidence: Full raw-text extraction of the Barbados Immigration Department's official Passport page (immigration.gov.bb/pages/Passport.aspx) confirms verbatim: 'The photographs should not be more than five (5) centimetres by five (5) centimetres and should be taken by a professional photographer.' This matches the DB value exactly. Note: a page image titled 'Photo Head Size Template' shows only the outer 5×5cm frame with no internal head-height measurement text, so head_height could not be confirmed from this source despite third-party sites (not used here) claiming 30-40mm.
